sentences.text:
And Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Pawan Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajeev Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2.  The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is filed with the prayer to quash the impugned order dated 26.7.2023 issuing non bailable warrant against the applicant in S.T. No.826/2018,
arising out of Case Crime No.632/2018 under Section 376-AB, 506 I.P.C. and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Gomti Nagar, Lucknow.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant was falsely implicated in the present case as he is attending the court since 2019 regularly but unfortunately he was not well on one day Shivam Alias Saini Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt. ... on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185637473/
1 and he informed to his counsel for moving exemption application but due to inadvertent mistake,
same could not be moved, therefore, non bailable warrant was issued against the applicant.

entities.text: Shivam Alias Saini Soni vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Home Deptt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that applicant is ready to cooperate in the trial, therefore, order dated 26.7.2023 may be set aside.
4. Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer of the applicant but he does not dispute this fact that on the basis of order sheet enclosed, the applicant appeared before the trial court regularly.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, going through the contents of the application, it is evident that the exemption application was not moved by the counsel for the applicant, therefore, non bailable warrant was issued and due to fault of his counsel, applicant may not be victimized, therefore, the impugned order dated 26.7.2023 and its consequential order is set aside.
6. In view of the above, the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
7. Trial Court is directed to proceed in accordance with the law.
